title: 인덕션 버튼 읽기: 어느 화구, 화력 몇, 몇 분?
objective: By the end, you can read an induction cooktop panel and find which burner is on, its heat level, its timer, and whether it is locked or still hot.
summary: Learners read the buttons and screen of a home induction cooktop to find the burner, heat level, timer and safety signs.
note: The panel words here are common examples. Your cooktop may use slightly different names or symbols.

task.title: Read the cooktop panel
task.line: Use the buttons and tips on page 1 to answer each question in Korean or with Yes/No.

items.text: Turns the whole cooktop on or off.
One cooking spot, often shown as 왼쪽 (left) or 오른쪽 (right).
Shows how strong the heat is; a bigger number is hotter.
Turns the burner off after the time you set.
Keeps cooked food warm with very low heat.
items.example: 국을 따뜻하게 두고 싶어요? 보온을 누르세요.

items.text: Stops the heat for a short time; press again to go on.
Locks the buttons so nobody can change them.
Shows that the glass is still hot after cooking.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Numbers: on many cooktops, 화력 1 is the weakest and 9 is the strongest. A small light next to a burner shows the one you chose. Read the number next to that light.
Safety: if no button works, 잠금 may be on. On many models you hold 잠금 for a few seconds to unlock it. After cooking, H can stay on for a while. Do not touch the glass until it goes off.

exercises: Read the screen and answer: 「왼쪽 화구 화력 7 · 오른쪽 화구 화력 2 · 타이머 15분」 ① Which burner is hotter? ② How many minutes is the timer?
Choose the button (전원, 잠금, 보온, 일시정지): ① 동생이 버튼을 자꾸 만져요. ② 아이가 울어요. 잠깐 요리를 멈춰요. ③ 찌개를 다 끓였어요. 가족이 30분 후에 와요.
Yes or No: 요리가 끝났어요. 화면에 H가 보여요. ① 지금 유리를 만져도 돼요. ② 아직 뜨거워요.
Put in order to boil eggs: 화력 8 / 전원 끄기 / 전원 켜기 / 타이머 10분
Fill in the blank with a word from the panel: ① 버튼을 눌러요. 그런데 아무것도 안 돼요. ____이 켜져 있어요. ② 20분 후에 자동으로 꺼져요. ____를 20분으로 했어요.
answers: ① 왼쪽 화구 (the left burner) ② 15분 (15 minutes)
① 잠금 ② 일시정지 ③ 보온
전원 켜기 → 화력 8 → 타이머 10분 → 전원 끄기
